ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABWDeTsA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6Pzg_mQi4", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 37, "title": "Complete PMX grant deformation: position and local rotation/translation, with private model inspection", "body": "## Goal

Complete PMX **grant / append bone deformation** in `three-mmd-loader`, covering **non-local translation grants**, **local rotation grants** and **local translation grants**, while preserving existing global rotation grants. Integrate correctly with VMD animation, direct/group bone morphs, IK, transformation classes and physics where defined.

This builds on SDEF (#26), direct bone morph (#28), group morph (#31), material morph (#33) and UV morph (#35). The implementation currently has TODOs in both the normal `GrantSolver` and `pmxAnimation: true` `updateOne` path: non-local position and local rotation/position are missing.

## Real MMD model candidates (found before opening this Issue)

**Primary — DONburi Room, 「オートグルーブボーン」, PMX edition**  
Creator distribution and instructions: https://donburiroom.blog8.fc2.com/blog-entry-162.html

The creator specifically states that the PMX version uses **translation/position grants (移動付与)** and bone morphs, while the PMD version cannot use translation grants; rotation multipliers and several stages are also described. The distribution is said to include a model already fitted with the mechanism. This is our best **local visual test for non-local position grants and grant chains**. Use the PMX variant, not the PMD variant. No archive was obtained or inspected during issue preparation: exact PMX grant flags, file availability and its README/license remain unverified.

**Secondary / exploratory — PAC 「時計塔」 (Clock Tower)**  
Creator's original distribution video: https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm17234819  
Creator-supplied download URL listed there: http://bowlroll.net/up/dl3639  
Local-grant technical discussion: https://mikudan.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-351.html

The clockwork gears use rotation grants with different ratios and are useful for the global-rotation baseline. The technical article describes enabling `L` (**local grant**) and **after-physics** on a particular bone, `1番車真親`, to get the intended post-physics linkage. **Do not claim the unmodified original clock tower already contains that local flag.** If a local modified test copy is needed, use it only privately and document the precise modification; check the original model archive's permissions first. This makes it an exploratory local-rotation/post-physics case, **not** independently verified as a ready-made local-grant fixture.

A third model may be substituted if inspection shows these are unavailable, don't contain expected PMX flags or cannot be used under their licenses.

## Implementation scope

- Preserve/read the existing `mmd-parser ^1.1.4` PMX grant metadata: `isLocal`, `affectRotation`, `affectPosition`, `parentIndex`, `ratio`, bone `transformationClass` and relevant flags. No new parser release should be required absent a reproducible parser defect.
- Implement the four grant cases independently **(non-local rotation, non-local position, local rotation, local position)**, and combinations on the same target, with correct rotation composition and displacement spaces. Do not confuse the PMX `isLocal` grant flag with a bone's **local-axis coordinate definition**.
- Respect MMD/PMX grant rules for authored VMD/VPD bone motion, bone morph contributions, upstream grants, IK-affected references and source/target skeletal parent transforms, including targets that are not direct children. Use a documented, independently cross-checked reference from PMXEditor / the PMX specification; distinguish editor-only behavior where MMD itself treats local grants differently. Do not uncritically transplant a different runtime's interpretation.
- Fractional, zero, negative and greater-than-one grant ratios, non-commuting rotations, parent motion, grandparent motion, multi-level grants, same-parent and different-parent grants, and mixed rotation+position chains must have explicit correct semantics and tests.
- Handle missing/out-of-range parents, self/cyclic grants and invalid/nonfinite input safely; no infinite recursion or NaN poisoning. Preserve unaffected skeletons, vertex and bone morphs.
- Integrate in **both** `MMDAnimationHelper` paths (default and `pmxAnimation: true`), eliminating double application, drift and order divergence. Define and test ordering relative to animation mixer → bone/group morph → grants/IK → physics, using PMX `transformationClass` and relevant before-/after-physics bone flags. If a requested full after-physics grant case is blocked by a broader inherited deformation-layer limitation, explicitly isolate it and provide a reproducible automated test, rather than silently claiming full support.
- Correctly update bone palettes, skinned positions/normals, SDEF, outlines, shadows and kinematic rigid bodies; physics should not erroneously overwrite grant behavior or reapply it across frames.
- Avoid accidental reliance on Three.js private APIs or unnecessary new public APIs; document any compatibility limitations.

## Optional local-only Grant inspector

Extend the existing loopback-only `npm run dev:sdef` private viewer, or add a similarly isolated Grant page.

- Support legitimate manually obtained PMX models and textures under `examples/assets/private/grant/`. Do **not** fetch or bundle real third-party models via automation.
- Inspect real `MMDLoader` output, listing grant source/target bone names and indices, `isLocal`, rotation/position flags, ratios, transformation classes, and pre/post-physics status.
- Show counts for each grant type and clearly indicate if the loaded PMX lacks position/local cases; do not report a visual pass for an absent flag.
- Provide a source-bone translation and rotation control with reset and optionally `MMDAnimationHelper`/VMD playback; highlight affected target bones and show current calculated transforms for comparison with MMD/PMXEditor where feasible.
- Respect original distribution and archive licenses. Keep archives, PMX, textures, VMD, README and screenshots private, Git-ignored, excluded from npm packages, static example builds, GitHub Pages and CI artifacts. **Existing public examples, their asset manifest, screenshots and URLs must remain unchanged.** Public example replacement needs its own license review and Issue.

## Fully automated pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated PMX fixture(s), parsed with the installed released parser, cover all four local/non-local × translation/rotation flag combinations, combined flags, multiple classes, signed ratios and asymmetric/nontrivial parent transforms.
- [ ] Independent CPU reference assertions validate rest pose, exact translation, quaternion composition and mesh skinning for weights/ratios at 0, fractional and full strength, plus negative and >1 cases. Include non-commuting rotations and distinct source/target parents to catch incorrect local/global-space math.
- [ ] Regression tests cover multi-stage/branching grants, bone/group morph inputs, VMD bone movement, IK-affected source bones, and PMX transformation ordering. The original non-local rotation case still behaves correctly.
- [ ] Both default and `pmxAnimation: true` produce consistent defined results without grant double-application or drift across repeated `update(0)`, pause/play, seek, VMD loops, VPD pose/reset, feature toggling and helper transfer.
- [ ] Physics and the known before/after-physics paths are tested with appropriate kinematic/dynamic rigid-body behavior. Unsupported broader deformation-layer behavior, if any, is precisely documented with failing-case fixture coverage or an explicitly scoped follow-up, not misrepresented as verified.
- [ ] Invalid indices, self-references, grant cycles and nonfinite inputs are contained, and do not hang or corrupt unrelated bones.
- [ ] WebGL2 mandatory browser tests compare actual rendered/skinned deformations, SDEF normals and outlines/shadows to independent expected values; native WebGPU where supported. Merely compiling a shader is insufficient.
- [ ] Loopback-only viewer inspects grant flags from actual parsed PMX, including generated CI fixture; no third-party asset or manual download needed to execute tests.
- [ ] Guardrails verify private viewer/assets are absent from `npm pack`, `npm run build:examples`, Pages and existing public assets.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run test:browser`, `npm run build:examples`, `npm run test:examples` and isolated npm package JS/TS consumers pass **before merge** (use the repo's documented fixture-assets environment mode if external example assets are unavailable).
- [ ] No model login/download, human visual signoff, post-merge Pages check, or npm release is required to complete the implementation PR.

## Required post-merge verification

**None** for Issue/PR completion. A later human-led optional check with the actual autogroove PMX / clock tower must be tracked separately and must not block merging or close/reopen prior completed feature Issues. Existing deferred real-model inspection Issue [#30](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/issues/30) remains untouched.

## References

- [PMX editor / spec discussion of local grant behavior](https://kkhk22.seesaa.net/article/312703073.html)
- [PMX specification — grant transformation rules](https://github.com/hirakuni45/glfw3_app/blob/master/glfw3_app/docs/PMX_spec.txt)
- [Existing implementation TODOs](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts)
